evidence.text: SCB's own retail series for building, hardware and paint stores (SNI 47.52, current prices) grew +9.3% y/y in Q2 2026 but slowed to +6.8% in July and +3.9% in August (+5.4% for Jul-Aug). Carrying even the smallest gap forward gives Swedish sales of roughly -1.5% to +2.5% and group sales of about SEK 2,000-2,035M including about +6% NOK translation on Other Nordic, which is below the SEK 2,049M consensus. evidence.why_not_priced: Two analysts cover the name.
